01

Overview

PermitPulse provides informational permit research, record organization, file review, and practical next-step support based on available public records and information supplied by the customer.

PermitPulse is not a government agency and is not affiliated with any permitting jurisdiction.

02

Informational-use disclaimer

PermitPulse does not provide legal, architectural, engineering, surveying, code-compliance, or other licensed professional advice.

Customers remain responsible for confirming requirements, deadlines, fees, filings, and decisions with the responsible jurisdiction and any appropriate licensed professional.

PermitPulse does not guarantee permit approval, the completeness of third-party records, processing times, or any particular outcome.

03

Public records and third-party information

Permit portals, agency records, maps, documents, and other third-party sources may be incomplete, delayed, changed, unavailable, or inaccurate. A review reflects the information available at the time it is prepared.

Links or references to third-party sources are provided for context. They do not mean PermitPulse endorses, controls, or is responsible for those sources.

04

Customer-provided information

Submit only information you have the right to share. You are responsible for the accuracy of permit numbers, documents, contact details, and other information you provide.

Do not submit highly sensitive personal information unless PermitPulse specifically requests it through an appropriate secure process.

05

Privacy notice

Information collected

The homepage permit-check form collects the permit number, city, county, or jurisdiction, a description of the permit issue, and an email address or phone number supplied voluntarily. If you contact PermitPulse or provide records for a review, PermitPulse also receives the information and documents you choose to provide.

The site and its analytics tools collect basic technical and usage information, such as the page visited, referring page, campaign parameters, and interactions with forms and links.

How information is used

PermitPulse uses this information to respond to inquiries, evaluate whether it can assist, perform requested review work, operate and improve the site, measure usage, and protect the service.

Service providers

Form submissions are processed by Formspree. Google Analytics and Cloudflare Web Analytics help measure site usage, and Cloudflare provides related site services. These providers may process information on PermitPulse’s behalf under their own terms and privacy notices.

Sharing and retention

PermitPulse does not sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers when needed to operate the site or provide the requested service, or when required by law. Information is kept only as long as reasonably needed for those purposes; no fixed retention period is promised here.

06

Service availability and changes

Site features, public-data sources, availability, and service scope may change. PermitPulse may update these terms and will publish the current version and its updated date on this page.

07

Acceptable use

Do not misuse the site, interfere with its operation, use it unlawfully, impersonate another person, submit information without authorization, or use automation that unreasonably burdens the service.

08

Intellectual property

PermitPulse branding, original site content, interface design, and original reports are protected by applicable intellectual-property rights. Government records and third-party materials remain subject to their respective rights and terms; PermitPulse does not claim ownership of public records.

09

Contact

Questions about these terms or privacy practices can be sent to hello@getpermitpulse.com.

10

Final legal notice

By using this site, you accept the terms posted here and understand that PermitPulse provides informational support with the limits described above.
